sentences.en: But for the safety belt, I wouldn't be alive today.
sentences.zh: 但要不是安全带，我今天可能就不在了。

sentences.en: Please make sure that your seat belt is securely fastened.
sentences.zh: 请确保您的安全带系紧了。

sentences.en: A tight belt will interfere with circulation of the blood.

senses.zh: 腰带, 带子区域, 地带
（用带子）系住；（作为惩罚用皮带等）抽打；击打
